YOUR BRAND

yourbrand.com

Branded end card — on every post, from every teammate

Pricing

## One plan. Every seat counts.

No tiers to compare, no features locked behind upgrades. Add teammates as the message grows.

The alternative? $370K+ per year for an in-house marketing team. [...] What exactly does Agent Craft do?

Agent Craft turns your team into a coordinated content engine. Each team member records a short voice note or video every day in the app; we handle formatting, narration, your logo and URL, hashtags, classification, analysis, adaptation to each platform's best practices, and posting across 8 social platforms — on your team's own accounts.

How much time does each teammate spend?

About 3 minutes a day. One short voice note or video, spoken the way you'd explain something to a colleague over coffee. No scripts, no editing, no writing. Everything else happens on our side.

Why post from personal accounts instead of the company page? [...] Post that, and you reach a professional audience that can directly advance your career. But you have to say something you might regret. I've watched plenty of execs freeze at that edge. The second camp wins, and it isn't close. When I launched Agent Craft, my sixth company, I told the real version: I built around an assumption that didn't survive first contact with prospects, realised the value wasn't in an individual product but in a team one, then pivoted, rebranded from Influence Craft, and relaunched. That's not a "thrilled to announce" post. That's the human experience of working through a hard problem, which is exactly what LinkedIn is missing. If you've posted the hard version, the one with the sharp edges left on, I want to know whether it paid off or bit you.
